diff --git a/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go b/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..6395c7590
--- /dev/null
+++ b/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go
@@ -0,0 +1,322 @@
+package trafficpolicy
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"reflect"
+	"strconv"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+
+	envoyroutev3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/config/route/v3"
+	envoy_type_matcher_v3 "github.com/envoyproxy/go-control-plane/envoy/type/matcher/v3"
+	"google.golang.org/protobuf/types/known/durationpb"
+
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway"
+	"github.com/kgateway-dev/kgateway/v2/pkg/utils/regexutils"
+)
+
+type consistentHashIR struct {
+	policy *kgateway.ConsistentHash
+}
+
+var _ PolicySubIR = &consistentHashIR{}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Equals(other PolicySubIR) bool {
+	otherCH, ok := other.(*consistentHashIR)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if c == nil && otherCH == nil {
+		return true
+	}
+	if c == nil || otherCH == nil {
+		return false
+	}
+	return reflect.DeepEqual(c.policy, otherCH.policy)
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) Validate() error {
+	if c == nil || c.policy == nil {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	p := c.policy
+	if p.Disable != nil && *p.Disable {
+		if len(p.Headers) > 0 || len(p.Cookies) > 0 || len(p.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(p.FilterState) > 0 || p.SourceIp != nil {
+			return fmt.Errorf("when disable is true, no other fields may be set")
+		}
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	for _, h := range p.Headers {
+		if h.HeaderName == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("headerName must not be empty")
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			if h.RegexRewrite.Pattern == "" {
+				return fmt.Errorf("regexRewrite pattern must not be empty")
+			}
+			if err := regexutils.CheckRegexString(h.RegexRewrite.Pattern); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid regex pattern in header %s: %w", h.HeaderName, err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	for _, cookie := range p.Cookies {
+		if cookie.Name == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("cookie name must not be empty")
+		}
+		if cookie.TTL != "" {
+			if _, err := parseTTL(cookie.TTL); err != nil {
+				return fmt.Errorf("invalid ttl %q for cookie %s: %w", cookie.TTL, cookie.Name, err)
+			}
+		}
+	}
+
+	for _, qp := range p.QueryParameters {
+		if qp.Name == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("queryParameter name must not be empty")
+		}
+	}
+
+	for _, fs := range p.FilterState {
+		if fs.Key == "" {
+			return fmt.Errorf("filterState key must not be empty")
+		}
+	}
+
+	return nil
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) IsDisabled() bool {
+	return c != nil && c.policy != nil && c.policy.Disable != nil && *c.policy.Disable
+}
+
+func constructConsistentHash(spec kgateway.TrafficPolicySpec, out *trafficPolicySpecIr) {
+	if spec.ConsistentHash == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	ch := spec.ConsistentHash.DeepCopy()
+	if len(ch.Headers) > 0 {
+		ch.Headers = deduplicateHeaders(ch.Headers)
+	}
+	if len(ch.Cookies) > 0 {
+		ch.Cookies = deduplicateCookies(ch.Cookies)
+	}
+	if len(ch.QueryParameters) > 0 {
+		ch.QueryParameters = deduplicateQueryParameters(ch.QueryParameters)
+	}
+	if len(ch.FilterState) > 0 {
+		ch.FilterState = deduplicateFilterState(ch.FilterState)
+	}
+
+	out.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		policy: ch,
+	}
+}
+
+func applyConsistentHash(ch *consistentHashIR, out *envoyroutev3.Route) {
+	if ch == nil || out == nil {
+		return
+	}
+	action := out.GetRoute()
+	if action == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if ch.IsDisabled() {
+		action.HashPolicy = nil
+		return
+	}
+
+	action.HashPolicy = ch.buildHashPolicies()
+}
+
+func (c *consistentHashIR) buildHashPolicies() []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy {
+	if c == nil || c.policy == nil || c.IsDisabled() {
+		return nil
+	}
+
+	p := c.policy
+	hasSubFields := len(p.Headers) > 0 || len(p.Cookies) > 0 || len(p.QueryParameters) > 0 || len(p.FilterState) > 0 || p.SourceIp != nil
+
+	if !hasSubFields {
+		return []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			{
+				PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+					ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+						SourceIp: true,
+					},
+				},
+				Terminal: false,
+			},
+		}
+	}
+
+	var res []*envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy
+
+	// 1. Headers
+	for _, h := range p.Headers {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header_{
+				Header: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Header{
+					HeaderName: h.HeaderName,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: h.Terminal,
+		}
+		if h.RegexRewrite != nil {
+			hp.GetHeader().RegexRewrite = &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatchAndSubstitute{
+				Pattern: &envoy_type_matcher_v3.RegexMatcher{
+					Regex: h.RegexRewrite.Pattern,
+				},
+				Substitution: h.RegexRewrite.Substitution,
+			}
+		}
+		res = append(res, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 2. Cookies
+	for _, ck := range p.Cookies {
+		cookie := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie{
+			Name: ck.Name,
+			Path: ck.Path,
+		}
+		if ck.TTL != "" {
+			ttl, err := parseTTL(ck.TTL)
+			if err == nil {
+				cookie.Ttl = ttl
+			}
+		}
+		for _, attr := range ck.Attributes {
+			cookie.Attributes = append(cookie.Attributes, &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_CookieAttribute{
+				Name:  attr.Name,
+				Value: attr.Value,
+			})
+		}
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_Cookie_{
+				Cookie: cookie,
+			},
+			Terminal: ck.Terminal,
+		}
+		res = append(res, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 3. QueryParameters
+	for _, qp := range p.QueryParameters {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter_{
+				QueryParameter: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_QueryParameter{
+					Name: qp.Name,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: qp.Terminal,
+		}
+		res = append(res, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 4. FilterState
+	for _, fs := range p.FilterState {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState_{
+				FilterState: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_FilterState{
+					Key: fs.Key,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: fs.Terminal,
+		}
+		res = append(res, hp)
+	}
+
+	// 5. SourceIp
+	if p.SourceIp != nil {
+		hp := &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy{
+			PolicySpecifier: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties_{
+				ConnectionProperties: &envoyroutev3.RouteAction_HashPolicy_ConnectionProperties{
+					SourceIp: true,
+				},
+			},
+			Terminal: p.SourceIp.Terminal,
+		}
+		res = append(res, hp)
+	}
+
+	return res
+}
+
+func parseTTL(ttlStr string) (*durationpb.Duration, error) {
+	if ttlStr == "" {
+		return nil, nil
+	}
+	d, err := time.ParseDuration(ttlStr)
+	if err == nil {
+		return durationpb.New(d), nil
+	}
+	sec, err := strconv.ParseInt(ttlStr, 10, 64)
+	if err == nil {
+		return durationpb.New(time.Duration(sec) * time.Second), nil
+	}
+	return nil, fmt.Errorf("cannot parse duration %q", ttlStr)
+}
+
+func deduplicateHeaders(headers []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader) []kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader {
+	if len(headers) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	res := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashHeader, 0, len(headers))
+	seen := make(map[string]bool)
+	for _, h := range headers {
+		key := strings.ToLower(h.HeaderName)
+		if !seen[key] {
+			seen[key] = true
+			res = append(res, h)
+		}
+	}
+	return res
+}
+
+func deduplicateCookies(cookies []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie) []kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie {
+	if len(cookies) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	res := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashCookie, 0, len(cookies))
+	seen := make(map[string]bool)
+	for _, c := range cookies {
+		if !seen[c.Name] {
+			seen[c.Name] = true
+			res = append(res, c)
+		}
+	}
+	return res
+}
+
+func deduplicateQueryParameters(params []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter) []kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter {
+	if len(params) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	res := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashQueryParameter, 0, len(params))
+	seen := make(map[string]bool)
+	for _, q := range params {
+		if !seen[q.Name] {
+			seen[q.Name] = true
+			res = append(res, q)
+		}
+	}
+	return res
+}
+
+func deduplicateFilterState(filterStates []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState) []kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState {
+	if len(filterStates) == 0 {
+		return nil
+	}
+	res := make([]kgateway.ConsistentHashFilterState, 0, len(filterStates))
+	seen := make(map[string]bool)
+	for _, fs := range filterStates {
+		if !seen[fs.Key] {
+			seen[fs.Key] = true
+			res = append(res, fs)
+		}
+	}
+	return res
+}

+	constructConsistentHash(p2Spec, &p2.spec)

+func mergeConsistentHash(
+	p1, p2 *TrafficPolicy,
+	p2Ref *ir.AttachedPolicyRef,
+	p2MergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	opts policy.MergeOptions,
+	mergeOrigins ir.MergeOrigins,
+	_ TrafficPolicyMergeOpts,
+) {
+	p1Field := p1.spec.consistentHash
+	p2Field := p2.spec.consistentHash
+
+	if p2Field == nil || p2Field.policy == nil {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if p1Field == nil {
+		p1.spec.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+			policy: p2Field.policy.DeepCopy(),
+		}
+		mergeOrigins.SetOne("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+		return
+	}
+
+	// p1 is higher priority than p2
+	if p1Field.IsDisabled() {
+		return
+	}
+
+	if p2Field.IsDisabled() {
+		return
+	}
+
+	mergedHeaders := deduplicateHeaders(append(slices.Clone(p1Field.policy.Headers), p2Field.policy.Headers...))
+	mergedCookies := deduplicateCookies(append(slices.Clone(p1Field.policy.Cookies), p2Field.policy.Cookies...))
+	mergedQueryParams := deduplicateQueryParameters(append(slices.Clone(p1Field.policy.QueryParameters), p2Field.policy.QueryParameters...))
+	mergedFilterState := deduplicateFilterState(append(slices.Clone(p1Field.policy.FilterState), p2Field.policy.FilterState...))
+
+	// The sourceIp scalar retains the higher-priority policy's value even when unset.
+	mergedSourceIp := p1Field.policy.SourceIp
+
+	p1.spec.consistentHash = &consistentHashIR{
+		policy: &kgateway.ConsistentHash{
+			Disable:         p1Field.policy.Disable,
+			Headers:         mergedHeaders,
+			Cookies:         mergedCookies,
+			QueryParameters: mergedQueryParams,
+			FilterState:     mergedFilterState,
+			SourceIp:        mergedSourceIp,
+		},
+	}
+
+	mergeOrigins.Append("consistentHash", p2Ref, p2MergeOrigins)
+}
